description: This file contains the implementation of a custom stream filter class and an abstract base class for stream filtering tests within an Orleans-based testing framework. It defines filtering logic based on filter data and includes test methods for various filtering scenarios.

classes.name: CustomStreamFilter
classes.description: Implements a stream filter that filters stream items based on provided filter data, such as 'throw', 'even', 'only3', and 'only7'.

classes.name: StreamFilteringTestsBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for Orleans stream filtering tests, providing common test methods and setup for different filter scenarios.

methods.name: ShouldDeliver
methods.description: Determines whether a stream item should be delivered based on the filter data.

methods.name: ShouldDeliverImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation of the filtering logic based on filter data.

methods.name: IgnoreBadFilter
methods.description: Test method to verify behavior when the filter throws an exception.

methods.name: OnlyEvenItems
methods.description: Test method to verify filtering of even items.

methods.name: MultipleSubscriptionsDifferentFilterData
methods.description: Test method to verify multiple subscriptions with different filter data.

methods.name: EnsureStreamFilterIsRegistered
methods.description: Checks if the custom stream filter is registered; throws exception if not.
